description: Source code implementing elliptic curve finite field element operations for BoringSSL, including conversions, arithmetic, and comparisons.

methods.name: ec_bignum_to_felem
methods.description: Converts a BIGNUM to an EC_FELEM, ensuring it is within the group field range.

methods.name: ec_felem_to_bignum
methods.description: Converts an EC_FELEM to a BIGNUM.

methods.name: ec_felem_neg
methods.description: Computes the negation of an EC_FELEM.

methods.name: ec_felem_add
methods.description: Adds two EC_FELEMs modulo the group field.

methods.name: ec_felem_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one EC_FELEM from another modulo the group field.

methods.name: ec_felem_non_zero_mask
methods.description: Returns a mask indicating whether an EC_FELEM is non-zero.

methods.name: ec_felem_select
methods.description: Selects between two EC_FELEMs based on a mask.

methods.name: ec_felem_equal
methods.description: Checks if two EC_FELEMs are equal.
